answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize biometric entropy to act as an oasis for authentic identity verification. By requiring a unique physical signature, the system forces an attacker to acquire distinct biological hardware, which is as costly as refining ferrous ore into high-grade steel. If an agent attempts to simulate multiple identities without this verified nectar of individuality, the protocol imposes prohibitive computational and economic hurdles that effectively bankrupt any Sybil strategy.
